description: Land Acquisition - Maapalana, Kamburupitiya D/S Division, Matara District and Hokandara-North, Kaduwela D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes, including their exact locations, boundaries, and extents. The content focuses solely on land matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized categories.
